# Vendored, pinned dependencies

No download is needed to build the host engine.

* nlohmann/json **3.12.0**, `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp`, MIT license.
  https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0
* cpp-httplib **0.18.6**, `httplib.h`, MIT license.
  https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.18.6

The server uses plain HTTP behind an authenticating/TLS reverse proxy.
